description: Create a conversion goal. confirmed=false (default) returns a preview without writing; confirmed=true creates it.

confirmed.description: false (default) returns a preview without writing; true applies the change.

filters.description: Filters every conversion must match. properties.<key> filters apply to the conversion event; gt/gte/lt/lte compare numeric property values.

anyOf.description: properties.<key> matches a property on the conversion event itself.

ignoreHistoricData.description: true counts only data from the goal's creation date onward.

target.description: Page path for PAGE_VIEW (* matches any characters, e.g. /docs/*), event name for EVENT or CUSTOM.

type.description: PAGE_VIEW: target is a page path. EVENT or CUSTOM: target is an event name.

name: create_goal
title: Create goal
